title: Universal unramified parameter open for algebraic-space diagrams
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $A,C,B$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $p:A\to B$, $q:C\to B$ and $u:A\to C$ satisfy $q\circ u=p$. Fibre products use [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Local finite type and unramifiedness of space maps are tested on compatible etale scheme charts by [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-unramified-morphism]. Assume $p$ is locally of finite type and its underlying map $|p|:|A|\to|B|$ is closed, meaning it sends every closed subset to a closed subset, in the point topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. There exists an open subspace $W_{\mathrm{ur}}\subseteq B$ [def-a1-space-open-subspace] such that for every algebraic space $B^\prime$ and morphism $g:B^\prime\to B$, the morphism $g$ factors through $W_{\mathrm{ur}}$ if and only if the induced map $u_{B^\prime}:A\times_BB^\prime\to C\times_BB^\prime$ is unramified. In particular, when $B$ is a scheme, $W_{\mathrm{ur}}$ is an open subscheme of $B$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. No flatness or algebraicity-of-stacks assumption is made.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-lft-cancellation] to $A\xrightarrow{u}C\xrightarrow{q}B$: since $q u=p$ is locally of finite type, $u$ is locally of finite type. Thus [lem-sfb-space-unramified-locus-base-change] supplies its maximal unramified open $U\subseteq A$, whose points are precisely the unramified points of $u$.

Put $D=|A|\setminus|U|$ and $E=|p|(D)$. The open-subspace topology of [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] makes $D$ closed. The assumed closedness of $|p|$ makes $E$ closed. The open-subspace correspondence of [lem-a1-space-etale-open-image] therefore gives an open subspace $W_{\mathrm{ur}}\subseteq B$ with $|W_{\mathrm{ur}}|=|B|\setminus E$. This uses only closedness of the original map $p$, not universal closedness.

source.place: Tag 05X8 (lemma-where-unramified), construction of W; spaces-properties.tex Tag 03BZ (lemma-open-subspaces).

proof.text: Fix any $g:B^\prime\to B$. Set $A^\prime=A\times_BB^\prime$, $C^\prime=C\times_BB^\prime$, and let $r:A^\prime\to A$ and $p^\prime:A^\prime\to B^\prime$ be the projections. These are algebraic spaces by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The fibre-product universal property identifies $A^\prime$ with $A\times_C C^\prime$, compatibly with $u_{B^\prime}$: on each scheme test both sides consist of pairs $(a,b^\prime)$ with $p(a)=g(b^\prime)$, and the associated point of $C^\prime$ is $(u(a),b^\prime)$. Hence [lem-sfb-space-unramified-locus-base-change], applied to $C^\prime\to C$, gives $U(u_{B^\prime})=A^\prime\times_AU$. By [lem-a1-space-open-factor-scheme-tests], its point subset is $|r|^{-1}(|U|)$, so its complement is $D^\prime=|r|^{-1}(D)$.

source.place: Tag 05X8 (lemma-where-unramified), base-change argument; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 05W2; spaces-properties.tex Tag 03IE.

proof.text: We have $|p^\prime|(D^\prime)=|g|^{-1}(E)$. One inclusion follows from $g p^\prime=p r$. Conversely, if $b^\prime$ maps to $p(a)$ for some $a\in D$, the surjectivity $|A\times_BB^\prime|\to|A|\times_{|B|}|B^\prime|$ in [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] supplies a point $a^\prime$ over $(a,b^\prime)$. It lies in $D^\prime$ and maps to $b^\prime$, giving the reverse inclusion. Consequently $D^\prime=\varnothing$ if and only if $\operatorname{im}|g|\subseteq|W_{\mathrm{ur}}|$.

source.place: Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), used to spell out the final base-change inference of Tag 05X8.

proof.text: By the maximal-locus assertion of [lem-sfb-space-unramified-locus-base-change], $u_{B^\prime}$ is unramified if and only if $U(u_{B^\prime})=A^\prime$. Indeed an unramified map is unramified on the whole source, while restriction to its maximal locus is unramified by the cited statement. The full-point-image criterion in [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] identifies this with $D^\prime=\varnothing$. By step 4 this is equivalent to $\operatorname{im}|g|\subseteq|W_{\mathrm{ur}}|$, and [lem-a1-space-open-factor-scheme-tests] identifies that condition with factorization of $g$ through $W_{\mathrm{ur}}$; the converse follows simply by taking point images of a factorization. Finally, if $B$ is a scheme, the identity scheme test in [def-a1-space-open-subspace] says that $W_{\mathrm{ur}}=B\times_BW_{\mathrm{ur}}$ is represented by an open subscheme of $B$.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q38-93b0c05ac (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read Stacks 05X8 (spaces-more-morphisms.tex 11528-11563) against the item. The hypotheses match exactly: p locally of finite type and |p| closed, nothing more. The statement is unchanged and nothing was weakened. There are no new nodes and no repair note applies. Step 1 proves u is locally of finite type by cancellation (lem-sfb-space-lft-cancellation), which the source assumes silently; this makes the locus node lem-sfb-space-unramified-locus-base-change applicable. Step 2: D is closed because the point map of the open U is an open embedding; E=|p|(D) is closed because |p| is closed; W comes from the first clause of lem-a1-space-etale-open-image (03BZ). Step 3 identifies A×_B B' with A×_C C' on scheme-valued points, then uses the locus node's base-change clause and the 03IE point-image clause, giving D'=|r|^{-1}D. Step 4 proves |p'|(D')=|g|^{-1}(E) by point lifting (03H4 in lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus); closedness of p' is never used. Step 5: u_{B'} is unramified iff U(u_{B'})=A' iff D'=∅ iff g factors through W (03IE); the scheme case follows from the identity scheme test in def-a1-space-open-subspace. Small cases tested: dual numbers over k give W empty and agree; empty A, an isomorphism u, and empty fibres all behave correctly. Duplicate search on 05X8: the scheme version lem-sfb-closed-source-unramified-parameter-open is a special case, not a duplicate; lem-sfb-space-unramified-radicial-parameter-open (05X9) cites this item. lean.statement: theorem exists_openSubspace_universal_unramified_of_closed_source {S : Scheme.{u}} (A C B : AlgebraicSpace S) (p : A ⟶ B) (q : C ⟶ B) (u : A ⟶ C) (w : u ≫ q = p) (hp_lft : MapIsLocally (@LocallyOfFiniteType) p) (hp_closed : IsClosedMap (mapPoint p.hom.hom)) : ∃ W : OpenSubspace B, (∀ (B' : AlgebraicSpace S) (g : B' ⟶ B), (∃ l : B'.obj.obj ⟶ W.val.toFunctor, l ≫ W.val.ι = g.hom.hom) ↔ MapIsLocally (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsUnramified) (X := ⟨Limits.pullback p.hom g.hom, (fibreProduct_isAlgebraicSpace A B' B p g).1⟩) (Y := ⟨Limits.pullback q.hom g.hom, (fibreProduct_isAlgebraicSpace C B' B q g).1⟩) (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.map p.hom g.hom q.hom g.hom u.hom (𝟙 B'.obj) (𝟙 B.obj) (by simpa using (congrArg (fun k : A ⟶ B ↦ k.hom) w).symm) (by simp)))) ∧ (∀ (T : Over S) (e : B.obj.obj ≅ yoneda.obj T), ∃ (V : Over S) (j : V ⟶ T), IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧ ∃ eW : W.val.toFunctor ≅ yoneda.obj V, W.val.ι ≫ e.hom = eW.hom ≫ yoneda.map j)
